name: Quote Acceptance and Policy Creation
description: When a UWQuote reaches status Accepted, create the UWPolicy from it, link the two records and raise a policy-setup task. The policy payload is assembled inside the BUILD_POLICY eval and passed as ONE object, not as 24 separate JSONPath values: an unmatched JSONPath resolves to an empty array, and sending [] where the schema wants a string or number fails validation with a 400 that is only visible in the run log. The policy reference derives from the QUOTE id, because the policy id does not exist until after the create call. NOTE: record-triggered, so it does NOT fire when a person saves the form.
